test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In the wake of the information technology revolution in India, which of the following capitals has been occupying the most dominant position?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Human capital.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Information Technology in India** is a vast industry which comprises** information technology services, consulting, and outsourcing.**
 
• Beside Artificial intelligence technology in IT, Human capital has been occupying the most dominant position in its functioning.
 
• The domestic revenue of the IT industry** from imports is estimated at US$45 billion.**
 
• **Export revenue is estimated at US$150 billion** in FY 2021.
 
• The IT-BPM sector overall employs 4.5 million people as of March 2021.
 
• The Indian IT-BPM industry has the** highest employee attrition rate.**
 
• As a global outsourcing hub, the Indian IT industry is dependent on cheap labour.
 
• Major IT companies in India are** TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Tech Mahindra etc.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Material, Plant and Machinery are necessities for Manufacturing Industry.**
 
• **Majors sectors of Indian Economy:**
 
 
• **​Primary Sector**
 
 
• The primary sector in India is the sector which is **largely dependent on the availability of natural resources** in order to manufacture goods and also to execute various processes.
 
• **Example of this sector is the agriculture sector.**
 
• The other examples in this sector include **fishing and forestry**
 
• **​Agriculture accounts for the largest** in this sector.
 
 
 
• **Secondary Sector**
 
 
• ​The economy in the sector is dependent on the natural ingredients which are **used to create the services and products offered and which in the end are used for consumption.**
 
• The major examples that fall under this category are **transportation and manufacturing.**
 
 
 
• **​Tertiary Sector**
 
 
• ​This sector** contributes the largest in terms of share in GDP **in India.
 
• The sector is** also the service sector** and is important when you consider the development of the other two sectors.
 
• An example of this sector is all service sectors which **IT services, consulting, etc.**
